title: Lightheaded on standing

steps.warm: Dizzy is real. Please sit or lie down as soon as it starts.

steps.warm: Before you stand, squeeze a soft ball or clench and release your hands.

steps.warm: If you have to stand a while, marching your feet in place may help.

emergency.text: Call 911 if your blood pressure is still above 180/120 on a second reading and you have chest pain, shortness of breath, back pain, numbness, weakness, vision change or trouble speaking. Do not wait to see if it comes down.
